Almond (Ward 1) — Edinburgh, United Kingdom

In detail

87.3 crimes per 1,000 population in 2023/24, the fourth-highest of Edinburgh's 17 wards, and independently placed in the highest of five crime-rate bands by a second analysis of Police Scotland's own published data through end of 2025. No ward-specific incident beyond the rate itself was found in local press, so the tone here follows the numeric rate plainly rather than any invented detail. Sources checked: Churchill Support Services / Scottish Daily Express, 28 Nov 2024; datamap-scotland.co.uk Police Scotland ward crime map, data to end 2025.
